entities.summary: Roman Málek is a former Czech professional ice hockey goaltender who played in the Czech Extraliga, Russian Superleague, and Swedish Hockey League. He was selected by the Philadelphia Flyers in the 5th round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft but did not play in America.
